title: Finite coefficient model of a cover over the punctured power-series base
statement: Let $B$ be a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], $n>0$, $T=\operatorname{Spec}(B[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]])$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], and $t:T\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ the constants-induced morphism. Let $V\subsetneq T$ be open, containing every point whose contraction is not the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $p:E\to T$ be finite and etale over $V$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Write $U$ for the complement of the closed point in $\operatorname{Spec}B$ and $W=t^{-1}U$. There exist a finite $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}B$, with depth at least two at all source stalks above the complement of $U$, and an isomorphism $E|_W\cong(Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}B}T)|_W$ over $W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. No depth hypothesis on $E$ outside $V$, no isomorphism over all of $T$, and no etaleness of $g$ is asserted.

proof.text: Write t for Spec of the constants map and s for Spec of constantCoeff. The identity constantCoeff composed with C = id gives s composed with t = id. Set W=t inverse U. The hypothesis haway gives W subset V, so restricting p to W is finite etale, by the cartesian square for nested open restrictions. The identity s composed with t identifies s inverse W with U. Pull p restricted to W back along s restricted to W and compose its projection with this open identification to obtain a finite etale cover f over U. No assertion about s inverse V is needed.

The only point outside U is the closed point. Its stalk is ring-isomorphic to B, using the localization at the maximal ideal and the structure-sheaf stalk isomorphism. This isomorphism is a flat local map; the flat local depth formula gives depth of the stalk at least depth B, hence at least two.

Apply the finite depth-two extension theorem to f over U to obtain a finite g:Y -> Spec B, depth at least two at every source stalk above the complement, and an isomorphism e0 between g restricted to U and f. Because f is etale, e0 also makes g restricted to U etale.

Put r=the second projection of Y times_Spec B T. Pasting its pullback square with the open restriction square, then cancelling the restriction square of g, proves that r restricted to W is the base change of g restricted to U along t restricted to U. It is therefore finite etale. Pull this square back along s restricted to W. Since the composite of this section with t restricted to U is the open identification s inverse W -> U, an isomorphism, the induced map k from this zero-section pullback to Y restricted to U is an isomorphism. Compose e0 inverse with k inverse to get an isomorphism between the zero-section pullbacks of p restricted to W and r restricted to W. Cancelling the open-identification isomorphism in its structure-map equation verifies that it lies over s inverse W.

The zero-section inverse image of W is U, as proved in the first step. Apply full faithfulness on the punctured power-series zero section to W. Its bijections on all morphism sets supply full and faithful instances for the finite-etale pullback functor. Take the preimage of the preceding isomorphism, and forget to schemes. The finite-etale morphism equation gives exactly e.hom composed with r restricted to W = p restricted to W. Combine this with the finite and boundary-depth properties of g.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_power_series_punctured_finite_model
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := B) B)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) B))).Opens) (hproper : V ≠ ⊤)
    (haway : ∀ v, (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin n)))) v ≠
      IsLocalRing.closedPoint B → v ∈ V)
    {E : Scheme.{u}} (p : E ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) B)))
    [IsFinite p] [Etale (p ∣_ V)]
    (U : (Spec (.of B)).Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint B) :
    let t := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin n) (R := B)))
    let W := t ⁻¹ᵁ U
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B)), IsFinite g ∧
      (∀ z : Y, g z ∉ U →
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := Y.presheaf.stalk z) (Y.presheaf.stalk z)) ∧
      ∃ e : (p ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme ≅ ((Limits.pullback.snd g t) ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme,
        e.hom ≫ (Limits.pullback.snd g t) ∣_ W = p ∣_ W
